texte.Le graphique montre une courbe réaliste: The chart shows a realistic curve surrounded by a pessimistic/optimistic range (dotted area), more realistic than a single fixed projection. The results card also shows the range in figures at month #.
texte.Le lien Voir les # critères d évaluation: The View the # assessment criteria → link explains the full scoring methodology.
texte.Le lien entre les choix techniques et la: The link between technical choices and the bill, on volumes you have declared.
texte.Le marché réel, pas le marché annoncé: The real market, not the announced market
texte.Le marquage lisible par machine est une: Machine-readable marking is an obligation of the system’s PROVIDER: knowing whether you are one decides what you owe.
texte.Le marquage n’est pas une formalité : il: Marking is not a formality: it determines what you will be able to state later about the origin of the code.
The audit module is not loaded yet. Open the AI Act audit tab first.
texte.Le module mesure par FAMILLE, pas par me: The module measures by FAMILY, not by control: the exact distribution of controls per baseline is not reproduced here. A ratio whose denominator was assumed would be worth less than its absence. And this catalogue is not certified: no body issues an attestation against it.
texte.Le modèle de comparaison applique des pa: The comparison model applies discount tiers (-#% from # systems, -#% from #, -#% from #+), for a more realistic comparison than a linear rate.
texte.Le montant ne classe pas à lui seul : c’: The amount alone does not classify: it is the cross-check that decides, and that is what you will be asked to justify.
texte.Le montant que vous arbitrez, calculé su: The amount you are deciding on, calculated on what your teams have declared — never estimated on your behalf.
texte.Le moteur lit les lignes du Registre IA: The engine reads the rows of the AI register that have no classification, and proposes for each a class, the article that supports it, and the extracts from your declaration on which it relies.
texte.Le moteur n’écrit jamais le registre: The engine never writes to the register
texte.Le motif est nommé, jamais générique. «: The reason is named, never generic. “This PDF contains no text: it is a scanned image” calls for optical character recognition; “PDF reading is not available on this server” is an installation problem, not a file problem. A document rejected in a batch does not stop the others: the upload continues and lists its rejections at the end.
texte.Le médecin reste responsable de la décis: The doctor remains responsible for the final decision — AI cannot replace clinical judgement. Document the chain of responsibility explicitly.
texte.Le même geste commercial qui vous a fait: The same commercial move that made you an integrator made you change tier. That is the figure to take to the committee deciding whether to industrialise an integration offer.
texte.Le même inventaire sert à l’IA Act et au: The same inventory serves the AI Act and the GDPR: it is always written once too often, never once too few.
texte.Le même profil ne donne pas le même rada: The same profile does not give the same radar in healthcare and in logistics. Comparing your radar with another organisation’s only makes sense within the same sector.
texte.Le navigateur a enregistré la réponse sa: The browser saved the response without decompressing it.
texte.Le navigateur a enregistré une page sous: The browser saved a page under the name of the expected file: page
texte.Le niveau de risque et les obligations e: The risk level and the exact obligations, before you have committed any compliance spending.
texte.Le niveau de risque et les obligations l: The risk level and the legal obligations.
The name of the use is required.
The processing activity name is required.
texte.Le nom d’une personne et une échéance. «: A person’s name and a deadline. “Senior management” and “in the second quarter” are not answers.
texte.Le parc, d’abord — pas le site témoin: The estate first — not the showcase site
texte.Le parcours commence par une question —: The path starts with a question — new build, extension or acquisition — because the same criteria are not read in the same order. Follow the branch of your project to the end.
texte.Le parcours investisseur commence par un: The investor path starts with a question — new build, extension of an existing estate, or acquisition/M&A — because the same criteria are not read in the same order. NEW BUILD: electricity decides before land, then climate/PUE/water, the connection queue, and due diligence (price and PPA, an enforceable timeline, water at the exact point). EXTENSION: where the operator already is, the country’s density, the connection queue that announcements reserve, and the extension permit that is never a given. M&A: status as a scale of certainty, the declared/calculated record, then the list of data room questions the framework cannot decide — PUE measured over twelve months, contractual connection, leases, committed CAPEX, ownership structure. The address carries the scenario (#parcours=invest.ma): send each person the right path.
texte.Le passage du constat à l’instruction :: The move from finding to examination: the audit produces the documents that the next matrix will prioritise.
texte.Le passage du tableau au dispositif : un: The move from the table to the framework: a role without a holder in the tool shows, a role without a holder in a document does not.
texte.Le passage à l’échelle sans perdre la tr: Scaling up without losing the trail: on a register of several dozen systems, the reading is automated, the DECISION is not, and each classification keeps the name of whoever made it.
texte.Le piège propre au code généré : un test: The trap specific to generated code: a test written from the implementation always passes, including when the implementation is wrong. The test must come from what is EXPECTED, not from what was produced.
texte.Le plafond de la charge de preuve y est: The burden-of-proof cap is ALREADY applied there — the card and the module's screen return the same number, and not two truths about the same rate.
texte.Le plafond, et pourquoi il est affiché: The ceiling, and why it is displayed
texte.Le plan de sensibilisation reste à réali: The awareness plan remains largely to be done.
texte.Le plus bas des cadres évalués — c'est l: The lowest of the frameworks assessed — it is the one that governs
texte.Le plus bas des deux plafonds s'applique: The lower of the two ceilings applies (SME, Art. #(#))
texte.Le plus bas des deux plafonds —: The lower of the two ceilings —
texte.Le plus durable, le plus bruyant. À rése: The most durable, the noisiest. Reserve it for areas where the origin changes what a reviewer must do — otherwise the marking becomes noise people stop reading.
texte.Le plus élevé des deux plafonds s'appliq: The higher of the two ceilings applies
texte.Le plus élevé des deux plafonds —: The higher of the two ceilings —
texte.Le poids suit la charge réglementaire et: The weight follows the regulatory load and not the number of paragraphs: chapter # weighs three times chapter #, and chapter # — post-market monitoring, serious incidents — as much as chapter #.
texte.Le poids suit la charge réglementaire, p: The weight follows the regulatory load, not the number of paragraphs
texte.Le point de départ sur les huit piliers,: The starting point on the eight pillars, the budget and the duration come
texte.Le point où un refroidissement évaporati: The point where evaporative cooling competes for use with agriculture — that is often where the permit is decided, not in the electrical file.
texte.Le pourcentage mesure une reprise de PRE: The percentage measures a carry-over of EVIDENCE, not compliance: it does not say that these articles are met, still less that the authority will accept it. And the trap of this graft is the scope — that of the management system is chosen by the organisation, that of the Regulation is not.
texte.Le premier bloc de la page ne montre auc: The first block of the page shows no amount. It cross-checks two things that neither the register nor the costing sees on its own: a system classified HIGH-RISK, in service, and for which nobody has said what it consumes. That is the first row to deal with, before any decision on caps — a system that carries the heaviest obligations of the Regulation and whose budget has not been examined is the worst of both worlds.
texte.Le premier bloc ne montre aucun total. U: The first block shows no total. An estate of twenty systems of which three are declared produces a credible and wrong figure, and nothing flags it: a total does not say what it does not know. Read the coverage, chase the missing declarations, and only then the indicators.
texte.Le prix réel de l’électricité est un con: The real price of electricity is a contract: public statistics do not see it, never cite them as the project price.
texte.Le produit relève de l'annexe I mais n'e: The product falls under Annex I but does not require third-party conformity assessment: the condition of Article #(#)(b) is not met, so the system is not high-risk on that basis. A product subject to third-party assessment for risks other than health and safety (radio spectrum, electromagnetic interference with no effect on health or safety) does not meet that condition either (Art. #(#c)).
texte.Le présent contrat définit les modalités: This contract sets out the terms of RaaS (Results as a Service) pricing, under which the Client pays the Provider according to the verified achievement of AI Act compliance milestones, and not according to a flat fee.
texte.Le présent contrat est soumis au droit f: This contract is governed by French law. Failing an amicable settlement, any dispute relating to its formation, performance or interpretation falls within the jurisdiction of the Tribunal de commerce de Paris [Paris Commercial Court].
texte.Le présent contrat prend effet à sa date: This contract takes effect on the date it is signed by both parties and remains in force until the final compliance attestation is achieved or it is terminated under the conditions of ordinary law. It is concluded in accordance with Articles # and # of the French Civil Code, which give binding force to lawfully formed agreements and require them to be performed in good faith.
texte.Le présent règlement établit des règles: This Regulation lays down harmonised rules for the placing on the market, the putting into service and the use of AI systems in the Union, while respecting fundamental rights, democracy, the rule of law and environmental sustainability.
texte.Le périmètre du SMIA n’est PAS celui du: The scope of the AIMS is NOT that of the ISMS. Taking over the # scope without examining it is the most common mistake in this graft.
texte.Le périmètre est celui du parc CARTOGRAP: The scope is that of the MAPPED estate
texte.Le questionnaire, les verrous et le scor: The questionnaire, the locks and the score all depend on it: the standard addresses its requirements to the provider and passes them on to the deployer through the instructions for use.
texte.Le radar seul ne suffit pas : croisez-le: The radar alone is not enough: always cross-check it with the FRIA details for high-risk systems.
texte.Le rapprochement le plus utile n’est pas: The most useful correspondence is not point by point: GOVERN overlaps clauses # and #, and nothing in the framework requires a Statement of Applicability.
texte.Le rapprochement n’est pas une interprét: The correspondence is not an interpretation: it is declared in module #, measure by measure, and it is what makes the plan defensible before an authority.
texte.Le ratio valeur/effort seul ne départage: The value/effort ratio alone does not separate two equivalent cases; risk does.
texte.Le registre des traitements (RGPD art. #: The records of processing activities (GDPR Art. #) and the AI systems register are two separate objects. The same tool can appear in both, for different reasons.
texte.Le registre est incomplet : complétez le: The register is incomplete: complete the fields of Article #.
texte.Le registre est le point d’ancrage de to: The register is the anchor point of the whole file: documentation, audits and evidence are attached to it.
texte.Le repérage de vos marchés sur une échel: Placing your markets on a common scale — two countries that “regulate AI” can require it in incomparable ways.
texte.Le retour chiffré au dossier de valeur s: The quantified return in the business case presupposes the redesigned process.
texte.Le retour chiffré à l’étape # suppose le: The quantified return at step # presupposes the redesigned process. For the cases left blank below, this figure describes a gain that nothing will go and collect.
texte.Le risque, en euros et non en couleurs: Risk, in euros and not in colours
texte.Le règlement Machines (UE) #/# est passé: The Machinery Regulation (EU) #/# has moved from Section A to Section B of Annex I (Regulation (EU) #/#): for these products, only Article #(#), Article #a and Articles # to # apply (Art. #(#)). The requirements applicable to AI are added there by delegated act, applicable by # August # at the latest.
texte.Le règlement et le RGPD demandent un aut: The Regulation and the GDPR require an author, not an output.
texte.Le référentiel de gouvernance n’est pas: The governance framework is not loaded yet.
texte.Le référentiel du règlement est momentan: The Regulation’s reference framework is temporarily
texte.Le référentiel les nomme. Une analyse qu: The framework names them. An analysis that does not
texte.Le référentiel ne chiffre PAS votre parc: The framework does NOT put figures on your estate; confusing the two produces a declaration based on the average of others.
texte.Le régime commande les cinq écrans suiva: The regime drives the next five screens — and the articulation with NIS # is calculated along the way.
texte.Le régime de l’article # décide de tout: The regime of Article # decides everything that follows: twenty-six articles of Delegated Regulation (EU) #/#, or fourteen. The two sets are disjoint, and choosing the wrong title makes you pay for a programme half of which does not concern you.
texte.Le régime de supervision change tout — e: The supervisory regime changes everything — and an essential entity undergoes regular audits without any incident being necessary.
The regime has not been determined.
texte.Le réglage courant, et celui qui demande: The common setting, and the one that demands the most discipline: a secret pasted into a prompt is a disclosed secret, and the only remedy is to rotate it. Plan the rotation procedure before you need it, not after.
texte.Le rôle compte autant que le système : h: The role counts as much as the system: host, deployer and provider do not have the same obligations on the same tool.
texte.Le scoring multicritère combine : droits: The multi-criteria scoring combines: fundamental rights (FRIA assessment per system), data security and governance (Risk radar, # weighted dimensions), and regulatory performance (Compliance audit, # checkpoints).
texte.Le scoring oriente-t-il une décision ind: Does the scoring steer an individual decision?
texte.Le service ne voit jamais votre code. C’: The service never sees your code. It is the only setting where the question of confidentiality does not arise, and it greatly reduces the help you get.
texte.Le service s est arrêté pendant l import: The service stopped during the import and then restarted — most often
texte.Le seul indicateur qui distingue un plan: The only indicator that distinguishes a training plan that has been carried out from a training plan that works.
texte.Le socle DÉCOULE de la catégorisation :: The baseline FOLLOWS FROM the categorisation: announcing it as “High” without a risk assessment is a blocker, and the screen says so before you have filled in the rest.
texte.Le socle est le même pour les entités es: The baseline is the same for essential and important entities: only the SUPERVISION differs.
texte.Le socle, avant d’estimer une probabilit: The baseline, before estimating a likelihood
texte.Le superviseur principal peut demander l: The Lead Overseer can request the CONTRACTS themselves (Delegated Regulation (EU) #/#, art. #). A confidentiality clause negotiated with a client is no obstacle to this.
texte.Le support du comité de direction, tiré: The executive committee deck, drawn from the previous steps rather than re-entered.
texte.Le support prêt à l’emploi pour vos comi: The ready-to-use deck for your executive committees or boards of directors.
texte.Le système est déclaré NON génératif. Le: The system is declared NON-generative. The AI #-# profile does not
texte.Le système interagit-il avec des personn: Does the system interact with natural persons? → Art. # mandatory from # August #.
texte.Le système modère, classe ou influence-t: Does the system moderate, rank or influence people’s access to information or their expression?
texte.Le système peut-il affecter directement: Can the system directly or indirectly affect minors?
texte.Le système peut-il produire des résultat: Can the system produce differentiated results according to origin, gender, age, disability or economic situation?
texte.Le système traite-t-il des données perso: Does the system process sensitive personal or behavioural data beyond what is strictly necessary?
texte.Le système traite-t-il les personnes de: Does the system treat people in a dehumanising or instrumental way (e.g. rating, intrusive profiling)?
texte.Le sélecteur « fond » change ce que la c: The “background” selector changes what the colour encodes, without changing the map: documented cases by country, carbon footprint of the estate, or carbon intensity of the electricity grid. This last background explains the other two — a Polish centre at # gCO₂e/kWh and a Swedish centre at # do not have the same footprint for the same consumption. A GREY country has no data; it is not at zero. The fourth background, “National flags”, carries NO data: it is an orientation aid, and the legend says so — it evokes the colours, it does not reproduce the flags, whose coats of arms and crosses cannot fit within a territory.
